_notes: Paper (dry-run) only. compose_paper.py runs `docker compose up freqtrade` in the foreground and freqtrade_bridge.py polls its REST API.
Freqtrade is GPL-3.0: it runs as its own container and we only talk HTTP to it (bots/README.md).
Needs FREQTRADE_API_USERNAME, FREQTRADE_API_PASSWORD, FREQTRADE_JWT_SECRET in bots/wrapper/.env (owner only). No exchange keys for paper.
live stays empty: going live needs 3+ days of paper numbers, a reviewed PR and Joshua's own decision (docs/FLEET-PLAN.md).
